Why choose UNC-Chapel Hill?
Application Process
All incoming exchange students must be nominated by their home university by our posted deadlines.
Application Period
Summer, Fall, and Academic Year
:
Nominations open December 1
Nominations due February 15
Student applications due March 1
Spring and Calendar Year
:
Nominations open August 1
Nominations due September 1
Student applications due September 15
Nominate a student
Please contact the Incoming Exchange Advisor (incoming_exchange@unc.edu) if you are unable to meet the nomination deadline. Nomination forms must be completed by a university representative. Students cannot complete a nomination form on their own behalf.
Once students get nominated, an email will be sent to the student and nominator with the application link.
Please ensure that students meet
eligibility requirements
prior to submitting a nomination.

Housing/Meals
On-campus rooms are traditionally double rooms and come fully furnished. Living on campus comes with built-in support to help you thrive both academically and personally. From tech support and safety guidance to room changes, laundry, and mail, Carolina Housing is here to make your day-to-day life easier and more comfortable. To learn more about housing options, visit Carolina Housing’s
website
.
Off-campus housing options may offer more privacy, apartment-style rooms, and the opportunity to explore the area around the University. The
Off-Campus Student Life Office
is a great resource to help you explore the Off-Campus market.
Students are encouraged but not required to purchase a
meal plan
, and can choose meal plan options that fit both on or off-campus living.
University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill | Off-Campus Housing Search

Health Insurance, Medical Care and Immunizations
Starting January 2026, all exchange students will need to purchase the premium plan of Student Blue for heath insurance. Review details about the mandatory health insurance and immunizations, and the medical services offered on campus.
Health Insurance, Medical Care and Immunizations
Estimated Expenses
Expenses will vary based on each student’s individual circumstances. Estimated costs are provided.
Review Estimated Expenses
Visa and Immigration
International exchange and Global Visiting Student Program students will apply for a J-1 Non-Degree student visa.
Visa Details
Mandatory Orientation
Once students are accepted, they will be notified of the dates of two meetings on zoom and the in-person orientation. All exchange students and Global Visiting Students are required to attend the in-person orientation at the start of their program. Orientation is scheduled the day before the first day of class (FDOC). Attendance is mandatory.
